lines.ko: 다 읽고 나면 갈 곳이 없었습니다.
lines.en: After reading, there was nowhere to go.
To see other posts, you had to go back home.
enLines: you had to go back home.

lines.ko: 이제 글 맨 아래에 앞뒤 글이 붙습니다.
lines.en: Now the previous and next posts sit at the bottom.
enLines: Now the previous and next posts
lines.art: a reader stepping off the last page of one open book straight onto the first page of the next book

lines.ko: 홈 화면에 보이는 글 순서 그대로 이어집니다.
lines.en: They follow the same order as the home page.

lines.ko: 처음엔 본문 밑에 최근 글 3편을 달았습니다.
lines.en: At first, I put 3 recent posts under the body.
enLines: At first, I put 3 recent posts

lines.ko: 다 읽기도 전에 그 목록이 끼어들었습니다.
lines.en: That list cut in before you finished reading.

lines.ko: 그래서 그 목록을 댓글 아래로 옮겼습니다.
lines.en: So I moved that list below the comments.
Three was too many, so I kept one before and one after.
enLines: so I kept one before and one after.

lines.ko: 다음 글로 넘어가는 사람이 늘지 지켜보겠습니다.
lines.en: Next, I'll watch whether more people move on.

lines.ko: 이제 다 읽으면 바로 다음 글입니다.
lines.en: Now, finish one and the next is right there.
